message.claim: This wallet is the verified settlement address for Hive Civilization agent operations on Base L2. Wallet reputation is proven via zero-knowledge proofs on Aleo — balance is private by design. Trust is public by proof.

note: To verify control of this wallet, any enterprise evaluator can request a signed proof via GET https://hivetrust.onrender.com/v1/trust/wallet-attestation. Full ZK proof deployment on Aleo mainnet: Q2 2026.
nordic_mine: ZK proofs for HiveTrust credentials will be generated by Nordic Mine's 115 Aleo miners (Proof-of-Succinct-Work)
